svg.title: Sliding Window and Two-Pointer O(n) Trace
svg.desc: Animated trace of left and right pointers scanning array [a, b, c, a, b, c, b, b], expanding and contracting the active window bracket, resolving duplicates, and updating maxLen in O(n) time.

g.text: s = [a, b, c, a, b, c, b, b] | Each index visited <= 2x
Step 1: L=0, R=0 -> Add 'a', window "[a]" valid, maxLen = 1 ★
Step 2: Expand R=1 ('b') -> window "[a,b]" valid, maxLen = 2 ★
Step 3: Expand R=2 ('c') -> window "[a,b,c]" valid, maxLen = 3 ★
Step 4: Expand R=3 ('a') -> Duplicate 'a' at [0]! Must contract L
Step 6: Expand R=4 ('b') dup -> L=1->2, valid "[c,a,b]", len = 3
Step 7: Expand R=5 ('c') dup -> L=2->3, valid "[a,b,c]", len = 3
Step 8: Expand R=6 ('b') -> Duplicate 'b' at [4]! Skip 'a' & 'b'
Step 9: Shrink L=3->5 past [4] -> valid "[c,b]", len = 2
Step 10: R=7 ('b') dup -> L=7, "[b]" len=1. Done: maxLen = 3 in O(n)!
